game.name: Gunman Clive
game.desc: Gunman Clive is a charming side-scrolling action platformer set in the Wild West, developed by Bertil Hörberg. Originally a mobile and 3DS release, this SNES homebrew port brings Clive's pencil-sketch art style and tight shooting mechanics to the Super Nintendo. Battle outlaws, robots, and bosses across short but satisfying stages with a distinct hand-drawn aesthetic.
